title: Cosmic Horned Sorcerer
description: A blue-skinned, horned humanoid figure with glowing eyes stands dramatically on an ancient stone platform inscribed with runes. He wears a long beige coat over a red vest and holds a glowing magical orb in one hand while raising the other, surrounded by a swirling cosmic portal, floating candles, cherry blossom branches, and drifting feathers.
prompt: A blue demonic sorcerer with large curved horns and glowing eyes stands on a rune-inscribed stone platform inside an ancient stone archway. He wears a long beige coat with red vest and purple pants, holding a glowing magical orb in one hand while casting with the other. A twisted tree with pink cherry blossoms grows beside him. Cosmic nebula sky with floating candles, feathers, and glowing particles fills the background, dramatic lighting from above, mystical fantasy atmosphere.
